description: This file defines the FnStream class, which implements the StreamInterface to create flexible, composable streams based on a hash of functions. It supports dynamic method handling, decoration, and stream operations, facilitating easy extension and testing of stream behavior.

classes.name: FnStream
classes.description: A dynamic stream implementation that composes behavior based on a hash of functions. It allows for decorating existing streams with custom functionality and supports lazy method handling and safe serialization behaviors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FnStream with a hash of method names to callables, dynamically creating methods.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Handles access to undefined methods, throwing an exception for unimplemented functions.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Calls the close function if defined when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object to avoid improper state restoration.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Creates a decorated FnStream over a given StreamInterface, filling in missing methods with defaults.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the stream to a string, handling exceptions gracefully.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream via the underlying function.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if available.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at End Of File.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Fetches metadata associated with the stream.
